last_completed_unit.target: Cargo package.links constraint and supported build-script override path
last_completed_unit.finding: Cargo documents that package.links requires a build script, while target.<triple>.<links> configuration can suppress compilation and execution of that links-associated script by supplying link directives and metadata ahead of time. Therefore package.build=false is not the documented suppression mechanism for a links-bearing package; the documented no-run path is the links override.
last_completed_unit.verified_scope: Cargo package.links and target.<triple>.<links> documentation semantics; no Cargo execution and no specific crate tested.
last_completed_unit.not_verified_scope: Specific-crate correctness without its build script, native/generated artifact availability, completeness of predeclared metadata, cross-target portability, build-dependency pruning, actual compilation, or end-to-end richer-mode parity.

source_scope: Current required repository controls for open_source, current own LATEST, SHA-only note-main freshness checks, and official Cargo Build Scripts plus Configuration documentation only.
scope_guard: Do not generalize the links override into proof that native discovery, native compilation, code generation, or arbitrary links-bearing crate preparation is eliminable.
